title: Signed BSGS: deterministic half-space coverage with paid distributed storage

claims.statement: For unrestricted uniform full-production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the deterministic classical cold attack in proof.md recovers x with probability at least 1/2 using at most 2^145 target-group-operation equivalents under C=1000. Peak storage is below 2^146 bytes; preprocessing is at most 2^145 equivalents included in total; zero nonuniform advice bytes (log convention 0). No heuristic assumptions. Analytic construction, not a practical or executed production attack.

experiments.purpose: Toy coverage, production-field small-table boundary fixtures, negative sign mutation controls and exact accounting; not production execution or timing.
